The '''''Coral Fin''''' was the personal [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] of the [[Priapulin]] [[Charza Kwinn]].<ref name="TCSWE" /> It was used during the [[Montitian Extraction|evacuation]] of [[Montitia]] during the [[Extorin Minor skirmishes]].
